title: Battle of Cape Palos (1815)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Cape Palos (1815)", at revision 1370436202, opens: "The Battle of Cape Palos was the last battle of the Second Barbary War. The battle began when an American squadron under Commodore Stephen Decatur Jr. attacked and captured an Algerian brig." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4873063, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1815 naval battle of the Second Barbary War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
